text:
aniket: main CI just turned red after merge 0a3f9c — compile-binaries hung on worker-17, no progress for ~12m. anyone nearby?
ci-bot: Build #54321 failed: step=compile-binaries timeout on worker-17. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/builds/54321/logs
devon: grabbing logs now, assigning to myself. @sre-oncall can you check if worker-17 is flapping or disk-io bound?
lina: quick grep on archived logs shows repeated 'Waiting for lock' around the same time, then stalls. command i used: `ssh worker-17 'tail -n 200 /var/log/runner.log | grep -i "Waiting for lock"'`
aniket: hmm could be nfs or concurrent artifact write. does a rerun usually help here?
devon: i'll queue a retry (retry=1) and watch. if it reproduces i'll attempt a revert of the doc commit to be safe.
ci-bot: Rerun queued: Build #54322 (retry of #54321).
sre-oncall: :eyes: i'm looking at worker-17 now — noticing high iowait and repeated 'nfs: server not responding' in dmesg. probable transient NFS issue. i'll cordon + drain worker-17 and re-route jobs.
lina: good catch. low-effort mitigation: make compile use tmpfs for /tmp in CI job so artifacts don't hit NFS for this step. i'll open a tiny CI-only fallback patch.
aniket: thanks. if #54322 passes we mark as infra-flake and close. if it fails, devon please start bisecting.
devon: update — #54322 succeeded. marking #54321 as infra-flake and notifying infra team for postmortem. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: Build #54322 succeeded.
